name: Show of Force
summary: Deputy Feldon sends you to drive gnoll packs back from Lakeshire. The Redridge guards need proof that the thrashers have been beaten.

sections.title: A Bold Encroachment
sections.body: Gnoll packs have grown bolder in the Redridge Mountains. Their camps now lie close to Lakeshire and the human homesteads beyond it. Stormwind has too few soldiers to spare for the borderlands, so local authorities depend on travelers to hold the perimeter. The gnolls have not yet struck the town, but their camps bring them within reach of its homes.

sections.title: Speaking Their Language
sections.body: Deputy Feldon knows the gnolls respect strength above all. He wants you to hunt their fiercest fighters, the gnoll thrashers, and bring back their spiked collars as proof of defeat. By breaking the front line and showing the trophies, Lakeshire's defenders hope to frighten the surviving packs into retreating to the highlands.

faq.q: Who offers this quest and where are they located?
faq.answer: Deputy Feldon offers this work from the town guard perimeter near Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains.

faq.q: Why are the gnolls pushing so close to Lakeshire?
faq.answer: The gnolls have grown bold while Lakeshire's defenses are stretched and Stormwind sends little military aid. They have established hunting camps close to human settlements.

faq.q: What enemies need to be defeated for this mission?
faq.answer: You are sent after gnoll thrashers, the more dangerous fighters in the local packs, who wear spiked collars.

faq.q: Why does Deputy Feldon want spiked collars specifically?
faq.answer: Deputy Feldon wants the thrashers' collars as a show of strength, to frighten the other gnolls into retreating to the hills.

faq.q: Can Stormwind provide soldiers to deal with the gnolls?
faq.answer: Stormwind has sent almost no reinforcements, leaving Redridge to defend itself amid instability and troop shortages across the kingdom.

faq.q: Where are the gnolls typically encamped in Redridge?
faq.answer: Gnoll camps lie across the hills and low ridges by Lake Everstill and along the roads east toward Stonewatch.

angles.text: Lakeshire is one of the Alliance's easternmost strongholds in the southern Eastern Kingdoms. Its borders must hold against attacks by wild beasts.
As a human, Redridge's settlers and townsfolk are your fellow subjects of Stormwind. They are left exposed to marauders and rely on their own people to drive them back.
As a warrior, you meet the gnolls with direct force. They yield only to strength, so disciplined fighting at the front can break their ranks.
